header.notice: EVERY VALUE IN THIS FILE IS INVENTED. The hosts, users, passwords, keys, tokens, paths, SQL and e-mail addresses are made-up shapes that look like Creatio, SQL Server and PostgreSQL answers; none was copied from a real site. No real host, login, password, key or token may ever be added here. SiteTextRedactionFixtureSafetyTests fails on anything shaped like a real secret or a real place.
header.provenance: The Accelerator host lane's redaction cases (electron test/kitSiteResponse.test.ts at b9786609, PR #389, safeSiteMessage), expanded to their 350 distinct inputs and classified A/B/C/D by the clio lane's gap analysis of 2026-11-19.

classes.A: clio already removed what the host removes; the marker wording may differ.
classes.B: the host removes it and clio did not; closed by the site-text redaction plan, rule per kind.
classes.C: the host keeps it on purpose (the site's reason, prose, a code); clio must keep it too.
classes.D: the host removes it - a documented trade of its own, or a shape clio declines by choice (plan rules 7 and 8, analysis kind 10) - and clio keeps the site's words.
classes.E: the host keeps it, and clio removes it because master removed it: after Bearer only the documented trades of the Bearer floor stay. clio keeps the words around it.

entries.redact: SensitiveErrorTextRedactor.Redact must satisfy the row, and so must RedactSiteText.
entries.site: RedactSiteText must satisfy the row; Redact must still keep every mustStay fragment.

header.fields: mustGo: the secret core that must not appear in the output (a host, a user, a token, a password, a stack frame line), not a phrase around it, so a partial redaction cannot pass. mustStay: the phrases that carry the site's reason and must appear verbatim, cut where clio's placeholders sit (a whole input when clio keeps all of it), never stop-words alone. hostOutput: the host lane's own result, for reference only. pending: asserted in a later PR (its mustStay are the host's content words).
